For the one who makes

From boat rides at golden hour to kayaking out into water so clear it barely looks real — this year gave you a lot of good days. Here's hoping the next one gives you even more.

Happy birthday. May it be as bright as every sky in these photos.

the year, in stops

A Little Journey

a dedication

Before anything else, this: good health. It's the quiet thing behind every trip, every photo, every good day — easy to forget until you need it, so here's to never having to think twice about it.

Life won't always be a golden-hour boat ride. There will be storms, and stretches that test you far more than any current. When those days come, I hope you meet them with everything you've got — and I hope you win. Every single battle.

So: a strong body, a stubborn heart, and a spirit too bright to dim. That's the wish. Happy birthday.

"Wishing you a year that feels like a long, warm, unhurried island day — the kind you never want to end."

Happy Birthday!
